2643: pub open spec fn page_organization_pages_match_data(

2645:     pla: PageLocalAccess,

2648:     popped: Popped) -> bool
2649: {
2650:     psa.points_to.is_init() && (
2651:     match (*pla.count.value(), *pla.inner.value(), *pla.prev.value(), *pla.next.value()) {
2652:         (count, inner, prev, next) => {
2653:             &&& (match page_data.count {
2654:                 None => true,
2655:                 Some(c) => count as int == c
2656:             })
2657:             &&& (match page_data.full {
2658:                 None => true,
2659:                 Some(b) => inner.in_full() == b,
2660:             })
2661:             &&& (match page_data.offset {
2662:                 None => true,
2663:                 Some(o) => psa.points_to.value().offset as int ==
2664:                             o * SIZEOF_PAGE_HEADER
2665:             })
2666:             &&& (match page_data.dlist_entry {
2667:                 None => true,
2668:                 Some(page_queue_data) => {
2669:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(prev, page_queue_data.prev)
2670:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(next, page_queue_data.next)
2671:                 }
2672:             })
2673:             &&& (match page_data.page_header_kind {
2674:                 None => {
2675:                     (page_id.idx == 0 ==> {
2676:                       &&& !page_data.is_used
2677:                       &&& (match popped {
2678:                           Popped::SegmentCreating(sid) if sid == page_id.segment_id =>
2679:                               true,
2680:                           _ => inner.xblock_size != 0
2681:                       })
2682:                       &&& (!popped.is_SegmentCreating() ==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2683:                     })
2684:                     && (page_id.idx != 0 ==> page_data.offset == Some(0nat) ==> (
2685:                         (!(popped.is_Ready() && popped.get_Ready_0() == page_id) &&
2686:                             !(popped.is_VeryUnready() && popped.get_VeryUnready_0() == page_id.segment_id && popped.get_VeryUnready_1() == page_id.idx))
2687:                           ==>
2688:                         (page_data.is_used <==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2689:                     ))
2690:                 }
2691:                 Some(PageHeaderKind::Normal(_, bsize)) => {
2692:                     &&& page_id.idx != 0
2693:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2694:                     &&& inner.xblock_size != 0
2695:                     &&& inner.xblock_size == bsize
2696:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2697:                     &&& page_data.offset == Some(0nat)
2698:                 }
2699:             })
2700:         }
2701:     })
2702: }
